items.author: flacoelcielito5.bsky.social
items.context: Oh damn 😭 did you buy lots of games on sale? Ill admit i dont have a steam account yet! But that’s gonna change in a few weeks 👀 so ik I gotta be careful
items.text: Smart to be careful before the first account. Once you have it, wishlist whatever catches your eye: Steam tells you when something on it goes on sale, so there's no pressure to buy on impulse.

items.author: jayveesto.bsky.social
items.context: wondered what took up so much space on my steamdeck, turned out it never properly deleted asssassins creed unity. i know this is a common deck issue with non steam games but i still blame ubisoft cause why the fuck are that game together with your launcher a ridiculous 50gb???!!
items.text: Ugh, 50GB hiding out of sight is frustrating. The Storage page in the Deck settings shows what's taking up space, which is a good first stop when something doesn't add up.
items.verify: Проверьте, что в настройках Steam Deck есть раздел Storage, где виден занятый объём.
